messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 03:05 UTC — increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate served by cluster 'eu-west-1-prod' (p95 latency spike). Pager: @Ashish (oncall). Incident page: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0423
Ashish (oncall): acked — jumping in. grabbing logs and checking autoscaler. @Maria can you watch routing?
Maria (SRE): on it. initial look: rapid backlog on model-router-k8s, observed KV cache thrash and >600ms spikes to backend for some requests. no full node OOMs.
Ashish (oncall): reproducing with curl against staging routing rules, trying to compare baseline. running: `curl -s -X POST https://eu-west-1.prod.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` to check error codes
Jordan (runtime): seeing a surge of long-lived KV lookups in the inference runtime. looks like stale cache keys + concurrent warmups. pushing a temporary routing rule to divert traffic from model-variant v2-beta -> v2-fallback for enterprise tier to reduce tail latency.
DevOps Pager: scaling pool 'dedicated-eu-1' by +2 nodes (graceful), ETA 90s for pods to be ready.
Dana (Customer Success): flagged by customer: AcmeCo seeing partial failures and timeouts, they reported some degraded responses at 03:03 UTC. I told them we're investigating and will update in 15m.
Ashish (oncall): mitigation: applied routing fallback for enterprise routes, throttled background eval traffic to free capacity. monitoring errors now.
Maria (SRE): logs (excerpt): ```
[03:04:12] runtime warn: kv_cache_miss_count=1242, concurrent_warmups=18, latency=612ms
[03:04:15] router info: route_attempts=4, fallback_triggered=true
[03:04:20] proxy err: upstream 503 from runtime-3
```
Jordan (runtime): added an immediate hotfix: reduce per-request KV warmup concurrency to 6, disabled aggressive prefetcher for v2 models. Applying patch to canary then prod.
Ashish (oncall): canary patch applied at 03:08 UTC. monitoring p95 and 5xx. initial drop in 5xx but some flapping.
Maria (SRE): after scale + routing change + patch, p95 back to normal within 6m, 5xx trending down. notifying customers.
Dana (Customer Success): updated AcmeCo at 03:16 UTC — they confirm fewer failed responses, but some earlier transactions still showing degraded content. asking for RCA and timeline.
sre-rotation: handing off to next oncall @Maria for post-incident follow-up. full handoff notes attached.
Maria (SRE): Handoff summary: incident started 03:03 UTC, peak impact 03:04-03:09, main contributors: cache warmup storm + routing fallback race condition + insufficient autoscaler headroom. Mitigations: routing fallback (03:06), scale +2 nodes (03:07 ready 03:09), runtime concurrency cap (03:08). Customer notifications started 03:10.
Ashish (oncall): filing postmortem and assigning RCA draft. I'll create postmortem doc and invite reviewers. Proposed owners: Maria (investigation), Jordan (runtime root cause), Lee (sign-off).
Jordan (runtime): adding notes for root cause section: interaction between prefetcher and model-variant routing produced overlapping warmups that exceeded per-host CPU; runtime didn't backpressure properly so proxy returned 503s under load. Also mention recent change that bumped prefetcher concurrency (PR #3421).
Maria (SRE): creating action items now: 1) revert prefetcher concurrency bump for v2 models (owner: Jordan, ETA 48h), 2) add headroom to autoscaler/cluster capacity policy (owner: DevOps Pager, ETA 1 week), 3) add a playbook runbook for kv warmup storms + routing (owner: Maria, ETA 72h), 4) customer-facing RCA (owner: Dana, ETA 24h).
Ashish (oncall): posted postmortem scheduling poll — propose doc review session tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Lee (Eng Dir): pls include cost/units impact and call out whether this would have been prevented by dedicated vs hosted routing rules. we need the economic impact for upsell/account expansion.
Maria (SRE): created draft RCA: https://docs.redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-0423-rca-draft (permissions: eng, cs). Draft includes timeline, logs, contributing factors, impact table by customer (AcmeCo: 112 failed requests, 8 min window), mitigation steps, and proposed followups.
Jordan (runtime): leaving inline comments on the doc. request peer review from @Lee and @Ashish.
Dana (Customer Success): prepping customer-friendly summary — will send to AcmeCo after internal sign-off. need ETA for formal RCA.
Ashish (oncall): reviewers requested. set internal review window 24h. any blockers for sign-off?
Lee (Eng Dir): quick read looks good. two asks: add a short section on monitoring (alert thresholds we should change) and a timeline of the rollout of PR #3421. If those are in, I can sign off by EOD.
Maria (SRE): updated doc with monitoring thresholds and link to PR diff for #3421. Also added recommended alert: p50->p95 delta > 250ms for router-prod should trigger pager.
Ashish (oncall): tagging action item board: https://kanban.redwood/INC-2026-0423. Items created and owners set.
Dana (Customer Success): scheduled customer follow-up email for 03:45 UTC after sign-off.
Lee (Eng Dir): sign-off: I reviewed the final draft, the timeline and mitigations are clear, owners assigned, and monitoring/alerts added. I sign off on the RCA for distribution. (reacts :white_check_mark:)
Maria (SRE): final postmortem published and linked in incident page. Closing thread — followups tracked in kanban. Thanks everyone for quick mitigation and clear handoff. (reacts :tada:)
